test_title: PYST 5: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct indirect speech of the sentence:

The man said, "Do you not realize how serious this is?"

options.text: The man asked if I did not realize how serious this was.
The man asked me did I not realize how serious it was.
The man told I don't realize how serious this is.
The man asked whether I did realize how serious this is.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** The man asked if I did not realize how serious this was.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **Reporting Verb:** The direct speech verb **'said'** is changed to **'asked'** because the sentence inside the quotation marks is an **interrogative sentence** (a question).
 
• **Conjunction:** For **Yes/No questions** (questions starting with auxiliary verbs like 'do'), the conjunction **'if'** or **'whether'** is used to join the reporting clause with the reported speech.
 
• **Tense Change:**
 
 
• The **Present Simple** negative **'do not realize'** is converted into the **Past Simple** negative **'did not realize'**.
 
• The verb **'is'** in the subordinate clause is changed to **'was'** to maintain tense consistency with the past reporting verb.
 
 
 
• **Pronoun Change:** The second-person pronoun **'you'** is changed to the first-person **'I'** (assuming the man is addressing the speaker).
 
• **Sentence Structure:** In **Indirect Speech**, the **interrogative form** (verb before subject) is changed into the **assertive form** (subject before verb). Hence, 'do you not realize' becomes 'I did not realize'.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *'The man asked if I did not realize how serious this was.'*

 

**Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** 'The man asked me did I not realize how serious it was.' 
 
 
• Incorrect because it retains the **interrogative word order** ('did I') instead of changing to assertive ('I did').
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** 'The man told I don't realize how serious this is.' 
 
 
• Incorrect because **'told'** is not used for questions without an object, and it fails to **backshift the tense** from 'don't' to 'didn't'.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** 'The man asked whether I did realize how serious this is.' 
 
 
• Incorrect because it removes the **negative 'not'**, changing the meaning of the original sentence, and fails to change **'is'** to **'was'**.
